capabilities: Edit programming and data-file formats inside Obsidian
Get completion, diagnostics, hover info, and go-to-definition from language servers
View a nested code outline and navigation breadcrumb
Show Git gutter indicators in the editor
Configure per-project language servers via onyx.toml
extras: Desktop-only. Language-server commands run without a shell and must be explicitly trusted per project; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's editor is built for Markdown, so editing code and data files lacks syntax highlighting, completion, and diagnostics.
summary: Source-file editor that opens programming and data files in Obsidian with CodeMirror 6 and language-server support.
